title: Bound on bounded-family sample count
statement: Let $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$ be rational and let $M$ be a positive integer. The bounded-family sample count, formed using accuracy $\varepsilon/(2M)$ and confidence $1/(20M)$, is at most $640M^3/\varepsilon^2$.
